title: Sugarcane farmers block highways across Karnataka for higher prices

tea.why: Sugarcane farmers protested to demand higher prices for sugarcane and sugar, and the implementation of the Swaminathan Commission recommendations.
tea.want: Protesters demanded Rs 5,500 per tonne for sugarcane, an MSP of Rs 60 per kg for sugar, and higher prices.
tea.changed: Oct 14: Protesters ended highway blockades and began a march to Hubballi after discussions with officials.

summary: Sugarcane farmers blocked national highways at multiple locations across Karnataka, including Belagavi, Bagalkot, Vijayapura, and Dharwad districts, to demand higher crop and product prices. The demonstrations disrupted traffic on major routes such as the Pune-Bengaluru National Highway and the Raichur-Solapur National Highway. Protesters lay down in front of vehicles and demanded the implementation of the Swaminathan Commission recommendations, a revision of the Fair and Remunerative Price for sugarcane, and a minimum selling price for sugar. The highway blockades concluded after two days, following which the participants transitioned into a march toward the hometown of Union Food Minister Pralhad Joshi. Local authorities, including Deputy Commissioner Mohammad Roshan, held talks with the participants and facilitated a phone call with Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar, who assured them that the state government would protect their interests.
demands: Minimum support price of Rs 60 per kg for sugar
Implementation of the Swaminathan Commission recommendations
Fair and Remunerative Price for sugarcane
response: Union Food Minister Pralhad Joshi appealed to farmers to withdraw their agitation, assuring that the Centre would address their concerns. Later, Deputy Commissioner Mohammad Roshan and Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar assured protesters that the state government would address their issues and carry their concerns to the Union government.

updates.text: Sugarcane farmers blocked national highways at several places in Karnataka, demanding higher prices and implementation of the Swaminathan report.
The two-day road blockade by sugarcane farmers ended, and participants launched a march toward Hubballi to protest near the Union Minister's house.
